title: Schooner Clearwater

services.name: Day Sail
services.desc: A relaxed 2-Hour Sunset Sail Along Clearwater Beach With Small Groups & No Crowds. Our Sunset Sail is a calm, unhurried way to experience Clearwater Beach at golden hour. This 2-hour evening sail focuses on real sailing - powered by the wind, shaped by the conditions, and timed to take in the sunset over the Gulf. There’s no narration and no set route, just open water, warm light, and time under sail as day turns to night. With a maximum of just 22 guests aboard our 52-foot classic schooner, the experience is peaceful and personal. services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: A fully private sailing experience for celebrations, gatherings, or quiet time on the Gulf. Our private sailing charters are ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, family gatherings, or simply enjoying time on the water with your own group. Each charter is 2.5 hours and reserved exclusively for you and your guests aboard our 52-foot classic schooner. You’ll sail with a U.S. Coast Guard licensed captain and experienced crew, with no narration or fixed route.
